What Is Interbrand's "Best Global Brands" Report, and What Does It Mean for Hyundai? Interbrand's "Best Global Brands" report is regarded as one of the most authoritative global brand valuations. Each year, Interbrand evaluates leading global brands across three dimensions: Financial Analysis, which measures the financial performance generated by the brand; Role of Brand, which measures the portion of the purchase decision attributable to the brand; and Brand Strength, which assesses a brand's ability to create loyalty to extend brand impact in the mid-to-long term. âThis year, Hyundai unveiled its AI robotics strategy, extending the brand into physical AI. IIHS Disclaimer: To qualify for 2026 TOP SAFETY PICK+, vehicles need good ratings in the small overlap front, moderate overlap front and side tests as well as acceptable- or good-rated headlights across all trim levels. In addition, winners need standard front crash prevention systems that earn a good rating in the pedestrian test and an acceptable or good rating in the vehicle-to-vehicle 2.0 test. If optional front crash prevention systems are offered, they must also meet those criteria.
